0022600155.text: The Nets (0-5, fifth in the Atlantic and 15th in the East) have lost five straight and are 0-3 at home and 0-2 on the road, while the Pacers (2-4, third in the Central and 12th in the East) have dropped three in a row. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), and Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), with Obi Toppin day-to-day from back soreness and a game-time decision. The Nets trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after Indiana won 136-109 in Brooklyn on October 25, and Brooklyn lost 1-2 to the Pacers in the 2025-26 season series.
